name: mirage
text:
v1.0.116 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.116
The Tracker's money now comes from Novig's own wallet records. The GitHub engine keeps your full Novig ledger and fills (every fill, fee, maker credit, settlement and transfer) in permanent files, and the app lays them over your bets: each bet's profit is its real settlement minus what Novig charged for its fills and fees, and a bet Novig has paid out settles from that payout. All-time and daily profit, charts and stats all use those figures. Your old bet records stay as labels only (teams, EV, closing line), so no CLV/EV is lost; I did not erase them. Not done yet: bets placed in the Novig app itself don't appear (the API can't see them), and the engine is still loading your first full history, so older days fill in over the next few minutes. Open the app, pull to refresh, and tell me any number that looks wrong.
